info.title: CENTRAL COOLING S.W. SYSTEM P & I DIAGRAM

texts.text: ALL VALVES ARE SHOWN IN NORMAL OPERATING POSITION.
INSTRUMENT IDENTIFICATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH ISA 5.1.
SEA WATER PIPES TO BE GALVANIZED STEEL OR CU-NI 90/10.
SEA CHESTS TO BE PROVIDED WITH VENT AND STEAM / AIR BLOW-OUT CONNECTIONS.

classes.gate_valve: bow-tie with a vertical bar in the middle
classes.check_valve: open bow-tie with a vertical bar at the outlet side (no fill)
classes.sdnr_valve: open bow-tie with an outlet-side bar and a filled centre dot
classes.ball_valve: bow-tie with a large filled circle
classes.pump_centrifugal: circle with a tangential discharge stub
